label: Khurchan
note: From khurchana, Hindi for to scrape; Old Delhi and Khurja, Mathura; Not reduced to a solid like rabri: the scraped skins are the product

about.text: A North Indian winter sweet of scraped layers of cream skin from simmering milk, sweetened.
